claim: C3: PD-L1/CD274 rises after CLDN4 loss, or after TROP2 ADC

literature.sn38_PDL1_literature: contradictory (up via STING/STAT1 in some models; down via FoxO3a in HNSCC)

arm_A_public.GSE207704_note: deposited FPKM is one value per condition; CLDN4 residual RNA remains high

honesty: No title/abstract in Europe PMC states that CLDN4 knockdown or knockout raises PD-L1.
Tight-junction / claudin-low / CLDN18.2 papers are lookalikes and were not counted.
SG + pembrolizumab trials are not PD-L1 induction experiments.
GSE207704 directions disagree across two lines and the deposit collapsed replicates.
GSE312098 CD274 is statistically up but FPKM stays <1; GSE311016 (same paper, PDX 29d) is flat.
E-MTAB-16849 / 16433 are real open SG single-cell series; they were not quantified here because the processed matrices are 0.9–23 GB.
Bulk TCGA CLDN4 vs CD274 is not a loss-of-function test and is purity-confounded.
CCLE (no infiltrate) is weakly positive, the opposite of low-CLDN4 => high-PD-L1.
